subject: Disputed charge + multiple auth failures (3DS) — evidence & card update
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novalabs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Anika Mehta <cfo@novalabs.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Urgent: customer dispute + repeated auth failures on last invoice

Hi Marcus,

We received a chargeback notification this morning for invoice #NOVA-20261101 (amount €18,750). Our payments team also flagged several authorization failures from the card on file over the last 72 hours — the gateway shows 3DS/authorization declines with reason "auth_required" and then a later "fraud_decline". The customer (cardholder) says they didn't recognize the charge and opened a dispute through their bank.

Can Redwood provide the transaction metadata and any evidence (signed invoice, order confirmation, IP/location, device) we can submit to the bank/Stripe? We need this consolidated to respond to the dispute within the 7-day window. Also, how should we proceed with updating the card on file to retry the pending balance without risking additional declines?

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Finance Manager, Nova Labs
[Attachment: bank_chargeback_notice.pdf]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novalabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Urgent: customer dispute + repeated auth failures on last invoice

Hi Sanjay — sorry you're dealing with this. We'll get a compiled evidence packet and a short plan for retrying payment. Quick answers first:

- We can provide: signed invoice PDF, gateway auth logs (timestamps, last4, auth code), customer acceptance IP, and fulfillment confirmation.
- For retries: recommend creating a fresh payment attempt using a new payment method (card update) rather than repeatedly retrying the failing token. We can guide you through a token swap flow or generate a secure card-update link.

Monica (billing ops) — can you assemble the Stripe evidence bundle and include the merchant descriptor + settlement timestamps? Laura — can you confirm whether we can issue a temporary invoice credit while the dispute is in-flight (so customer access is preserved)?

I'll also book a short screen-share with your payments team if that helps.

— Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_evidence_template.docx]
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novalabs.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Urgent: customer dispute + repeated auth failures on last invoice

Hi Sanjay, Marcus — attaching the evidence we can provide to Stripe for a card-not-recognized dispute. Packet includes: signed invoice (invoice_NOVA_20261101.pdf), merchant descriptor screenshots, fulfillment logs (order id, timestamps), and the gateway auth trace.

Notes:
- Gateway shows three auth attempts between 2026-11-17 02:12:33 UTC and 2026-11-19 21:04:07 UTC. Each failed with 3DS-required or fraud decline.
- We included device fingerprint and IP ranges used at time of purchase.
- Recommended response: contest with evidence packet and request reversal of chargeback. If bank sides with cardholder, Stripe may still pass the loss to you unless Stripe wins the dispute.

Regarding retries: we can generate a secure one-time card update link (PCI-compliant) to replace the stored token. I will include instructions. If you prefer, we can also take a manual card number over a signed secure link for immediate retry.

Attachments: invoice_NOVA_20261101.pdf, stripe_evidence_packet_NOVA.zip, card_update_instructions.pdf

Thanks,
Monica
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novalabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Urgent: customer dispute + repeated auth failures on last invoice

Thanks Monica — received the bundle. A couple follow-ups from our side:

1) VAT handling: this invoice is for EU-hosted services with VAT reversed in our records, but the card-issuing bank is showing the payment as an international merchant charge on the cardholder's statement and that seems to have triggered the unfamiliar descriptor complaint. Do you have a concise descriptor that matches what appears on receipts (we need the exact merchant string to reconcile)?

2) Can you provide a sample payload we should submit back to Stripe (what fields in the evidence are most persuasive)?

3) We prefer to update the payment method rather than storing a new card over email. Please send the secure single-use card-update link. We will coordinate with our procurement team for a token swap.

Also looping in Anika (CFO) for final sign-off on retrying the balance if we can guarantee limited retries.

— Sanjay
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novalabs.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Urgent: customer dispute + repeated auth failures on last invoice

Hi Sanjay / Anika — quick finance note:

- Merchant descriptor: REDWOOD*INFERENCE  (settles to Redwood Inference EU Ltd). We also have a secondary descriptor used for certain card processors: REDWD-INF. Please confirm which appears on the statement and forward a screenshot — that will materially help dispute reps.
- Evidence best-practices for Stripe disputes: include (1) signed invoice (2) proof of service access (logs showing user/session tied to the billing account) (3) shipping/fulfillment confirmation if applicable (4) communication trail where customer accepted terms. Monica's packet is well aligned.
- On retries: We'll allow a single controlled retry after card update. If retry fails again due to issuer-side 3DS gating, we will not re-attempt automatically; instead we'll escalate to a billing hold and a short account suspension pause until resolved.

I can join a 20-minute call Monday 2026-11-22 at 09:30 CET to walk procurement through the token-swap flow and review the evidence submission together. Marcus — can you send a calendar invite?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novalabs.com>, Anika Mehta <cfo@novalabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 13:00:00 -0500
Subject: Action plan & next steps — Nova Labs dispute and card update call scheduled

Hi team — quick summary and mutually agreed next steps so everything is in one place: 

1) Evidence bundle submitted to Stripe: Monica sent invoice_NOVA_20261101.pdf + stripe_evidence_packet_NOVA.zip on 2026-11-20. HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/7132 (please refer).

2) Merchant descriptor verification: Sanjay to forward the customer statement screenshot showing the descriptor. Laura confirmed our primary descriptor is "REDWOOD*INFERENCE"; alternate "REDWD-INF" may appear for legacy processors.

3) Card update and retry: Monica will send the secure single-use card-update link for Nova Labs' procurement team to complete. After successful token swap we'll attempt one controlled retry for €18,750. If the retry hits a 3DS/issuer flow and declines, we will not retry again and will proceed with the dispute resolution path.

4) Call scheduled: 2026-11-22 09:30 CET (20 min) — Marcus to send calendar invite and screen-share token-swap flow. Laura will join for any finance policy approvals.

5) Timeline expectation: evidence submission response in ~5–14 business days from Stripe; controlled retry will occur immediately after card update. If dispute is lost, we will provide reconciliation options and discuss credit terms.

If anything needs to change, reply-all and we'll update the MAP. Looking forward to the call.

— Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Related: https://app.stripe.com/disputes/DP_9yXb2Q]
